interpretation.illustrative_shelf_ring: These irregular fringe contours are VISUAL shore-adjacent candidate space, not continental shelf bathymetry, depth, slope, or passage data.
interpretation.headlands: Land protrusions can become rocky exposed points only if later lithology/wave-action assumptions support it.
interpretation.main_embayments: Some broad indentations may be exposed as bays, but drowned river valleys require actual pre-existing drainage relief and sea-level setting.
interpretation.branch_coves: Secondary indentation candidates near major bay entrances; no formally classified fjords, rias, estuaries or tectonic rifts.
interpretation.narrow_islands: 22 existing satellite islands have more elongated shoreline morphology; origins unresolved.

safeguards: No named or official ocean assigned to a new drawing coordinate
No determined tectonic history, glacier or sea-level chronology
All official geography relationships preserved on central supercontinent
The confirmed 32 Shattered Sea island chains are not identified with exactly 32 polygon elements
Do not infer actual kilometers or elevations from SVG map coordinates
